plot: Rex buys every tycoon upgrade and tries to buy Blox and Pixel's tycoon too; Zed presses the Mega Dropper, gold cubes pile up, and only joining both conveyors (and sharing 50-50) saves the day.

script.title: Rich Rex Bought EVERYTHING… Then This Happened 💰

beats.say: Out of the way! Cubes coming through! My dropper is going crazy!
Rex, your conveyor is going backwards! The cubes are flying everywhere!
Welcome to Tycoon Town, where every block you buy makes more money. In theory.
I bought every upgrade at once. Max droppers. Max speed. Max gold. Max everything!
Scanning. Your tycoon makes a thousand coins a second, and loses a thousand and one.
So I'm rich minus one? That's still rich, right?
Our tycoon is tiny, but look! One dropper, one belt, one coin at a time.
Slow, but it works. Every coin goes into the bank.
Rex's money board went crazy. Up, down, up, down.
Why is my number going down? I'm buying things! Buying things is winning!
Every upgrade costs money to run. You bought a hundred. They all want coins.
Woof?
Chip says: maybe buy fewer things and fix the ones you have.
Your dog doesn't know business. My dog would know business. If I had a dog.
Then Rex had an idea. A very Rex idea.
I'll just buy your tycoon too! Then I'll have two tycoons, and twice the money!
Our tycoon is not for sale!
Grrr. Woof!
Just then, Zed shuffled in, looking for a snack.
Hello. I smelled something shiny. Is it a snack?
Warning. Zed is walking toward the big red button.
Not the red button! That's the Mega Dropper! Don't touch it!
Oops. I touched it.
The Mega Dropper switched on. Gold cubes rained over the whole town.
Everybody take cover! It's raining gold cubes!
Wait. Too many cubes, and no conveyor to carry them. They're piling up!
Pile height: one Blox. Two Blox. Three Blox. This is a lot of Blox.
My gold! I can't sell it if I can't reach it!
Rex had the most money in town, and nothing worked.
I know! Our tiny conveyor works. If we join our belts, the cubes can roll to our bank.
You'd help me? After I tried to buy your tycoon?
Sure! But we share the money. Fifty-fifty.
Fifty-fifty? That's half! I hate half! Okay, deal.
So the team got to work. Pixel built, Blox pushed, Gizmo counted, Zed carried.
Pixel, the cubes are stuck! The pile is too heavy for the belt!
Then we need one more pusher. Someone strong. Someone who never gets tired.
Me? I am very strong. I am also very slow. But slow pushing is still pushing.
Zed leaned on the giant pile, and with one long zombie push, the cubes started rolling.
Go, Zed, go! Best zombie in the whole town!
Nobody ever cheered for me before. This is nice.
Belt connected. Cubes moving. Money going up. Up. Up!
And Chip found the very last gold cube, hidden under Rex's crown.
Hey! That's where I keep my emergency gold!
By sunset, the shared tycoon was the biggest in all of Tycoon Town.
I pressed one button and now we are rich. I'm good at business.
You're good at accidents. But this time it was a lucky one.
Okay, okay. Two tycoons that help each other beat one big messy tycoon.
Rex! Did you just learn something?
No! Maybe. Don't tell anyone.
But in the lobby, a fifth portal had just started to glow.
Next time on Blocky Quest: the secret portal nobody has ever opened.

long.title: Rich Rex Bought EVERYTHING… Then This Happened 💰
long.description:
Rich Rex bought every upgrade in Tycoon Town and now wants Blox and Pixel's tiny tycoon too. Then a friendly zombie presses the big red button… and it starts raining gold cubes!
